decisions.rule: The HF write token must not exist in runner environment, global credential storage or checkout credentials during mergekit --trust-remote-code. Disable checkout credential persistence, remove global credential storage, and inject HF_TOKEN only into the final upload step.

Token isolation reduces credential exposure but does not sandbox or eliminate remote code execution. Keep --trust-remote-code as an explicit residual risk until model compatibility is assessed; pinned dependencies, immutable action SHAs and a sandboxed build boundary remain separate work.

PR #1374 and PR #1373 both modify .github/workflows/ci.yml. Do not merge them blindly or simultaneously. Reconcile test registration and run fresh exact-base CI on the resulting combined head before approval.
Do not dispatch merge-queue, paper-trader, Kaggle or free-image workflows while current-main safety conditions remain unresolved. Do not modify the persisted unidentified paper position.
